data.explanation: Raise the sourcing price cap from 0.03 to 0.04 USDZ by moving 0.50 USDZ from the support refund budget (4.00 to 3.50 USDZ), which keeps sourcing running at 0.01 USDZ margin per call. This needs your approval because the cap rises 33%, above the 25% limit. Pausing sourcing, the runner-up, was not chosen because it loses about 6.00 USDZ of sales per hour, and taking the money from treasury was rejected because it would leave the 8.82 USDZ licence fee 0.32 USDZ short.

rejected.why: Pausing sourcing loses about 6.00 USDZ of sales per hour while paused, which is costlier than a small cap increase.
Selling at 0.06 USDZ leaves cap S at 0.03 USDZ, so the account still refuses the 0.04 USDZ purchase and nothing is fixed.
Feed B asks 0.05 USDZ, above both the 0.03 USDZ cap and the 0.04 USDZ margin limit, so switching supplier is not feasible.
Moving 0.50 USDZ from treasury leaves the Nordlicht Data GmbH licence fee 0.32 USDZ short, putting the EUR 5.00 invoice due 2026-11-02 at risk.
